core_problem_solved: To provide a universal and object-model-independent XPath engine for Java, allowing developers to execute XPath queries against various XML document representations (DOM, dom4j, JDOM, etc.) using a single API.
key_features: An adapter-based architecture for supporting multiple XML object models
Provides a single, consistent API for XPath evaluation regardless of the underlying XML parser
era_and_niche: A popular and powerful XPath library in the early-to-mid 2000s, especially in complex enterprise projects that used a variety of XML parsers and needed a consistent querying layer.
reason_for_obsolescence: It has been largely rendered obsolete by the inclusion of a standard XPath API (`javax.xml.xpath`) within the Java JDK itself since Java 5 (as part of JAXP 1.3). For most use cases, the native JDK implementation is sufficient and highly preferred in order to reduce external dependencies. The project is no longer actively maintained.
